average values for Swiss 50cc-150cc fleet: two-stroke: 45%, four-stroke: 55%

# Included processes
Dataset for operation of a scooter with a 50cc motor. Fuel consumption for two-stroke petrol included. Direct airborne emissions of gaseous substances and particulates matter according to HBEFA (2004) for motorcycles (with catalyst). Heavy metal emissions caused by tyre wear extrapolated from average passenger car emissions.
